summary.method: Line-anchored independent exact Fraction AST arithmetic only, no eval/exec. Skip ambiguous .ddd or ,ddd, remainder notation and percent-as-unit on right side. Strip Markdown bullets and whitespace before AST source segments.
summary.limits: Partial only; does not verify every equality or semantic plan. Most remaining flags are approximate/rounded equalities; flags are not source-error count. No certification of correctness. Supersedes preliminary parse inspection.
